q: Which Australian striker did Middlesbrough sign from Leeds United in 2004?
hint: Mark Viduka cost £4.5m and scored twice in the 4-1 second-leg win over Basel during the UEFA Cup run. He left for Newcastle United on a free in 2007.

q: Mark Schwarzer joined Middlesbrough in 1997 and stayed 11 years — which English club did he sign from?
hint: The Australian made just 16 appearances for Bradford City before the February 1997 move. He went on to make 446 appearances for Boro before joining Fulham in 2008.

q: Who was Middlesbrough's manager for the 2006 UEFA Cup final against Sevilla?
hint: Steve McClaren took charge in 2001 and left for the England job weeks after the Eindhoven final. Robson, Southgate and Strachan all managed the club, but in different years.

q: In 1989 Middlesbrough sold Gary Pallister for £2.3m, at the time a British record fee for a defender. Which club bought him?
hint: Pallister went on to form a title-winning centre-back partnership with Steve Bruce at Old Trafford; the fee was badly needed back on Teesside.

q: On the way to the 1997 FA Cup final, Middlesbrough were held 3-3 at Old Trafford by which third-tier side before winning the semi-final replay?
hint: Chesterfield, then in the old Second Division, came within minutes of reaching the final; Boro won the replay at Hillsborough 3-0.

q: Middlesbrough played at which ground for more than 90 years before moving to the Riverside Stadium in 1995?
hint: Ayresome Park was Boro's home from 1903 until April 1995, when the club moved to a newly built stadium on the town's old dockland.

q: Middlesbrough played at which ground for more than 90 years before moving to the Riverside Stadium in 1995?
hint: Ayresome Park was Boro's home from 1903 and hosted its last game in April 1995; the club began the following season at the newly built Riverside Stadium on the town's old dockland.

q: Then club-record signing Afonso Alves scored a hat-trick in an 8-1 home win on the final day of the 2007-08 season — against which club?
hint: Manchester City were dismantled at the Riverside in May 2008. Alves had arrived from Heerenveen that January for a fee of about €12m, a club record at the time.

q: Which Middlesbrough striker scored the decisive late goal in both of the 2006 UEFA Cup comebacks, against Basel and Steaua Bucharest?
hint: Massimo Maccarone struck in the 90th minute against Basel and headed an 89th-minute winner against Steaua, both completing recoveries from three goals down on aggregate.
